name: Leovic
appearance: Broad. Mule-bitten ear. Whip over one shoulder.
sayings: Goblins on the road at night. Going the wrong way.
wants: 2 guards for the next jar run east.
knows: Goblins cross the Luric Road at night, northbound by dawn.
offers: A seat on the cart, east or west.
dm_notes: Nighthowl spies. Zhallix frees goblins who bring news; these watch the Luric Road and carry what they see back north.
campaign_notes: Created 2026-10-07 in the Nemetra NPC quality test; drawn from Drive 'Nemetra Gnoll Threat'.
